Based on the image provided, here is the exact analysis of the yellow splash text:

**What it says:**
The text appears to read **"100! 1..."** or **"100! T..."**. It is heavily truncated, showing only the very beginning of the phrase before it is cut off by the right edge of the image frame.

**Is it readable?**
It is **partially readable but incomplete**. You can clearly make out the characters "100!" followed by a space and the beginning of another character (which looks like a "1" or possibly a "T"). The rest of the text is missing from view.

**Rotation and Positioning:**
*   **Rotated:** Yes, it is **rotated approximately 10-15 degrees clockwise**, exactly like Minecraft's standard splash text style.
*   **Clipping/Overlapping:** The text is **clipped** by the edge of the image. However, it does not appear to be garbled or overlapping with the gray title text ("VOXELCRAFT") in a messy way; it is positioned in the upper-right area above/behind the last visible letter of the title, which is standard placement for this type of UI.

In summary: The splash text says **"100! ..."** (incomplete), is **rotated** like the original game, and is **cut off** at the right border of this specific zoomed-in crop.
